changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.24

A full visual overhaul plus quality-of-life changes.

UI redesign
- Brand-new dark dashboard theme across the whole app: rounded card surfaces, a soft accent glow, and your accent color now drives every active/selected control.
- The main window is now a dashboard with a Clears chart (raid + dungeon) and a Blocked Traffic leaderboard showing how much each port has blocked (totals persist between sessions).
- Every window (Settings, Preferences, Keybinds, Swaps, QuickSwap, AHK Manager, Region Editor) shares the same look, header separator lines, and tinted background.
- All on/off options are now accent toggle switches.

Settings & windows
- Icon mode is a single Always / Popup / Confined selector instead of three separate switches.
- Only one feature window is open at a time: opening one closes the others.
- Removed clutter tips and tightened spacing.

Swaps
- Reorganized into Timing / Port & Mode / Loadouts / Finishing sections and fixed the overlapping controls.
- Swap mode (Updated / Legacy) now sits next to the Port toggle.

Loadout keys
- The Open Inventory and Open Loadouts keys are now fixed to F1 and Left Arrow for everyone (the per-profile bind boxes were removed). Make sure those match your in-game keys.

No changes to packet logic or the 27k behavior.
